verdict.rationale: Trello's docs cover creating task cards (including by email) and setting due dates on cards and checklist items. Assigning a card to a specific teammate is not explicitly documented; there is only a community mention of an easy "add people" feature, which may refer to board membership rather than card assignment. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on assigning cards or tasks to teammates, independent hands-on corroboration of assignment with due dates.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create tasks and assign them to teammates with due dates
